explain_anew.description: Re-explains a tricky concept a fresh way — an analogy, a story, or a simple walk-through — tuned to what interests you.

quiz_me.description: Serves a quick 3–5 question quiz on a topic, your due reviews, or your weak spots — and the score really counts.

worked_example.description: Walks you through a full worked example of a problem, one step at a time.

socratic_drill.description: Drills you with guiding questions and hints, never revealing the answer before you commit yours.

flashcard_forge.description: Creates a set of flashcards on a concept and saves them to your own question bank.

step_checker.description: Checks your working and points out the first step that went wrong — not just the final answer.

polyglot.description: Re-teaches a concept in a second language of your choice, side by side with English.

map_sight.description: Answers from your own knowledge map — what's nearby to explore, and honestly where the gaps are.

weakness_sight.description: Explains why a topic is a weak spot for you and suggests concrete next steps to strengthen it.

progress_mirror.description: Reflects your real progress back to you — courses, scores, certificates, and honest trends.

recap_scribe.description: Sums up your study session into a short note you can keep, correct, or forget.

photo_sight.description: Snap a photo of your homework or notes and it reads them to spot where you need help.

reminder_bell.description: Sets gentle review reminders timed for the moments you're most likely to forget.

path_weaver.description: Builds a personalised practice plan from your weak spots, due reviews, and goals.

goal_scribe.description: Suggests a few worthwhile next goals to pick from — you always make the final choice.

atom_forge.description: Writes brand-new practice questions on a concept and adds them to your question bank.

study_calendar.description: Exports your review schedule as entries you can add to your own calendar.

web_research.description: Searches the live web in a direction you point and returns a cited summary — always double-check the sources.

source_reader.description: Reads a link or document you supply and summarises it with citations back to the source.

fact_check.description: Checks a claim against live sources and gives you a cited verdict.

duel_second.description: Coaches you before and after a duel, drawing on your own match history.

dawn_briefing.description: Prepares a morning briefing before you arrive — what's due, your streak, and one thing to try.

watchful_eye.description: Keeps an eye out for new material in your subject and suggests refreshers when it appears.

long_weaving.description: A craft skill: lets your Companion's routines run more steps (up to eight).

twin_rituals.description: A craft skill: lets you keep more of your Companion's routines active at once (up to four).

weave_mastery.description: A craft skill: unlocks the visual routine builder with branching "if/then" steps.

kg_explore.description: Scouts new topics to explore next in a direction you choose, adding them to your map's suggestions.
